description: Operational safety check for a payment, separate from risk screening. Detects address poisoning (a lookalike planted in your history so it gets copied instead of the real address), contract recipients that would swallow the tokens, and addresses that behave differently on different chains. Pass known_addresses (the counterparties you already use) to enable poisoning detection. In our live-traffic sample this class of loss came up far more often than sanctioned counterparties. Dedicated transaction-security services cover part of it; no AML screening does. Run this together with onyx_decide before every payment.

address.description: Blockchain address (TRON, Ethereum or other EVM, Solana)

known_addresses.description: Addresses you have used before, so a lookalike can be spotted. Strongly recommended.
